rules.sentence: Pulmonary hypertension (PH) is defined as mean pulmonary artery pressure greater than 20 mmHg measured during right heart catheterization.

The term pulmonary artery hypertension (PAH) describes a subset of patients who also have the presence of pre-capillary hypertension, including an end-expiratory pulmonary artery wedge pressure (less than 15 mmHg) and a pulmonary vascular resistance greater than 3 Woods units.
